articles.title: Why the U.S. Might Make Your Morning OJ More Expensive
articles.summary: The U.S. plans a new 25% tax on stuff from Brazil, like coffee and orange juice, because of trade fights. Brazil's former president said tariffs aren't the answer. You can even tell the government what you think before July 1.

articles.title: California's Big Gamble: Can a New Map Flip Congress?
articles.summary: California redrew its voting map to help Democrats win up to five more House seats, fighting back against Texas. But in one San Diego race, nine Democrats are running—so many they might split the vote and lose to Republicans. Tuesday's primary is the first test.

articles.title: A $1.8 Billion Fund on Hold, and Primaries to Watch
articles.summary: A court stopped a huge $1.8 billion fund that was meant to help people who say the government treated them unfairly. Critics worried it might pay January 6 rioters. Also, six states vote today, with big governor races in California and Iowa.
